Kwame, the official handover of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2 Nov says "account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's cutover recap from 8 Dec 2025 also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

She kept running PHL day to day until 21 Nov to finish the terminal cutover, so you took over day to day on 22 Nov. For the CRM's official ownership date, use 2025-11-03. If the field is for when you started running the account, use 2025-11-22.
